title: Team-name normalization only strips the '-sp' suffix, so state-suffixed clubs never match
evidence: data.go:197 teamMatch compares only `a==b || TrimSuffix(a,"-sp")==TrimSuffix(b,"-sp")`; the datasets use state suffixes for every state (data/kaggle/Brasileirao_Matches.csv has "Flamengo-RJ", "Sport-PE", "Palmeiras-SP"). team_stats("Flamengo") matches zero rows — _factual.json: "got no Flamengo row found". Tests pass only because TestQueries uses "Palmeiras"/"Palmeiras-SP" (the one suffix handled).
suggestion: Strip any "-<UF>" state suffix (or normalize on a canonical-name map), not just "-sp".

title: Match files are concatenated without deduplication, inflating every play/goal count
evidence: data.go:57-79 LoadStore appends each file's rows unconditionally (`s.Matches = append(s.Matches, ms...)`); the 2019 Brasileirao appears in both Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (and BR-Football-Dataset.csv), so standings shows ~29 Atletico/Athletico rows where 2 are expected and every club's played-count roughly doubles — _factual.json.
suggestion: Deduplicate on (date, home, away) allowing a +/-1 day difference before aggregating.

title: Standings group by the raw team string, so no canonical club row is produced
evidence: server.go:102-107 Standings keys the map on x.Home/x.Away verbatim, so "Flamengo-RJ", "Flamengo" and accented variants become distinct rows; combined with the missing dedup this yields factual_accuracy=0.0 in _factual.json (29 Atletico/Athletico rows vs 2 expected).
suggestion: Canonicalize the team name (strip state suffix, fold accents) as the map key.

title: No head-to-head tool: no aggregated W/L/D between two named teams
evidence: main.go:20-22 registers only search_matches/team_stats/search_players/standings/statistics; server.go:143-181 CallTool has no head-to-head case. search_matches accepts home+away (server.go:157) but returns raw one-direction matches, not a two-team W/L/D record, and team_stats (server.go:159) has no opponent filter.
suggestion: Add a head_to_head tool that aggregates W/L/D and goals across both venues between two teams.

title: search_matches by team inherits the '-sp'-only normalization defect
evidence: server.go:35 filters via teamMatch(m.Home/m.Away, f.Team); data.go:197 only handles the '-sp' suffix, so search_matches(team="Flamengo") returns nothing against "Flamengo-RJ" rows. Same root cause as R6.
suggestion: Fix teamMatch to strip any state suffix; this repairs R3, R6, and R11 together.
